description: Presidential Secretariat - Establishment of a Presidential Task Force for Notional Deployment and Vaccination Plan for Covid-19 Vaccine
categorisation: This gazette contains both specific named individuals (Lalith Weeratunga, Major General Dr. Sanjeewa Munasinghe, etc.) AND detailed descriptions of their responsibilities and tasks related to COVID-19 vaccine deployment and vaccination planning. The document appoints individuals to a Presidential Task Force and outlines 13 specific responsibilities (a-m) that constitute detailed portfolio descriptions, making this a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3) according to the classification rules.
